title: Plux analytics: app overview
description: Sessions and release adoption of the selected apps (ANL-020).

list.name: organization
list.label: Organisation ID
list.description: The organisation UUID. Row-level security binds every query to it (SRV-022).

list.name: app
list.label: App
list.description: The apps of the organisation with rollups.

list.name: release
list.label: Release sequence
list.description: The release sequences of the selected apps with rollups.

options.content: **Not shown.** The rollups count events and keep no distinct-device column, so the number of active devices cannot be read from `analytics_rollups`. It needs a rollup dimension (ANL-010); until then this panel is absent.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Sessions started in the range (session_start events).

panels.title: Session ends
panels.description: Sessions ended in the range (session_end events).

panels.title: Releases seen
panels.description: Distinct release sequences with sessions in the range.

panels.title: Sessions by release
panels.description: Sessions per release sequence over time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.bucket, $__interval), r.release_sequence AS metric, SUM(r.events) AS value
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'session_start'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Release adoption
panels.description: Each release's share of the sessions in the range. Higher sequence numbers are newer releases.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
SELECT r.release_sequence AS "Release",
  SUM(r.events) FILTER (WHERE r.event_name = 'session_start') AS "Sessions",
  100.0 * SUM(r.events) FILTER (WHERE r.event_name = 'session_start') / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(r.events) FILTER (WHERE r.event_name = 'session_start')) OVER (), 0) AS "Share of sessions (%)"
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC;
